title: Pointwise input cost bound
statement: For every natural number $d$ and every sign vector $x$ of length $3^d$, the expected query cost of the randomized recursive three-way majority tree on input $x$ is at most $(8/3)^d$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $3^d$
